subject: Who creates invoices / VAT confirmation and delivery channel
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@acme-health.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Invoice origination / VAT and delivery preference

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo — we're ready to move forward but need to lock down a couple billing details before the SOW is final. Two quick questions from our AP team:

1) Which Redwood legal entity will be issuing invoices to Acme Health? We need the invoice issuer for our vendor onboarding (legal name, VAT/Tax ID).

2) Preferred delivery: our AP prefers invoices in the portal (it integrates with our ERPs) but they also ask to receive a copy by email to ap@acme-health.com for now. Is Redwood able to both publish invoices to the portal and fan out an email copy?

I attached our VAT certificate and the PO for the initial month. Can you confirm the sample invoice fields (VAT line, tax breakdown) will match our requirements?

Appreciate a short confirmation so we can finish vendor onboarding.

Best,
Elena
Director of Finance
Acme Health

Attachments: acme-EU-vat-cert.pdf, PO-8791.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@acme-health.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 12:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice origination / VAT and delivery preference

Hi Elena — thanks for the PO and the VAT cert. Looping in Kimberly and Connor to scope the delivery and legal details. Short answers up front:

- Invoice issuer: Redwood Inference Ltd (UK entity) will issue the invoices to Acme Health for this agreement. We will include the company registration and VAT number on each invoice.

- Delivery: We support publishing invoices to the customer portal and can also send an automated PDF copy to ap@acme-health.com. If you want the AP address added as a perpetual copy, we can set that up during onboarding.

Next steps I propose:
- Kimberly will confirm the exact VAT number format on the invoice and whether we need separate tax lines for reverse-charge (if applicable).
- Connor will share a sample invoice PDF that shows the line items + VAT breakdown for your finance team to approve.

Can you confirm whether Acme requires a separate VAT breakdown per line item or a single VAT total line? I can get this changed quickly.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--- Original attachment(s) received: acme-EU-vat-cert.pdf, PO-8791.pdf ---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@acme-health.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 02 Oct 2026 08:47:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice origination / VAT and delivery preference

Hi Elena, Jordan — quick compliance note from billing ops:

- We can issue from Redwood Inference Ltd (UK). Our billing system supports both a per-line VAT column and an aggregate VAT total. If Acme uses reverse-charge, we will render a "0.00" VAT amount per tax rule and add a note that the customer is responsible for the reverse charge; we can also include Acme's VAT number on the invoice header for audit purposes.

- Portal + email: confirmed. We will publish invoices to the portal (preferred for AP integration) and set up an automated email push to ap@acme-health.com. If you want the email copy to come from a dedicated billing@redwood.ai address, we can do that.

- Sample invoice: Connor, can you attach the EU sample we discussed that shows both per-line VAT and aggregate totals? Also include the field where we show the billing entity and VAT ID.

Elena, one small ask: please confirm the billing contact name (who will approve invoices) and whether you need a PDF-only invoice or also a structured XML/UBL file for straight-through processing.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

Related doc: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/invoice-samples#eu

From: Elena Morales <elena@acme-health.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice origination / VAT and delivery preference

Hi Kimberly, Jordan — thanks, that all sounds good.

Confirming:
- Billing entity: Redwood Inference Ltd is fine. Please include the VAT number and our VAT ID (on the attached certificate) on the invoice.
- Delivery: Portal is preferred for ingestion into our AP system, but please also send a PDF copy to ap@acme-health.com (permanent copy). Using billing@redwood.ai for the sender is fine.
- VAT breakdown: We need per-line VAT shown (our ERP reconciles by line). Reverse-charge: we will not be applying reverse-charge on this engagement; VAT should display as usual.
- Billing contact: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme-health.com> will be the approver.
- Structured file: PDF-only is OK for the pilot; if we move into automated processing we may request UBL next quarter.

Would you be able to send the sample invoice PDF that Connor mentioned so Maria can sign off? I attached the PO again.

Thanks — Elena

Attachments: PO-8791.pdf
